title: Direct deposits — setup and timing
summary: Explains how to set up Direct Deposit for Rho-Bank by using your online/mobile account and routing numbers, confirming account type/name with your payer, and following the payer’s enrollment process. Covers paycheck splitting across multiple eligible internal accounts and timing/posting based on the payer’s schedule (typically on scheduled pay dates, earlier if sent early).
faqs: How do I set up direct deposit for my Rho-Bank account?
What account details (routing/account numbers) do I need to provide to my employer/payer?
How can I split my paycheck across multiple Rho-Bank accounts (checking/savings)?
When will my direct deposit post—on the scheduled pay date or earlier?
If my first deposit doesn’t arrive when expected, what should I verify?
